scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY=false vp dev
scripts.owner:reset: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command "REPLACE INTO owner (id, generation, email) SELECT 1, generation + 1, NULL FROM owner WHERE id = 1"
scripts.owner:reset:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "REPLACE INTO owner (id, generation, email) SELECT 1, generation + 1, NULL FROM owner WHERE id = 1"
